name: @ahpd/agent-cofold
description: Cofold agent runtime integration for the Agent Host Protocol. Run it as an ahpd plugin or use it directly with @ahpd/sdk.
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Agent Cofold
ahpd.description: Run the Cofold agent runtime on any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

model.description: Default model for agents that don't set one.

baseUrl.description: Default OpenAI-compatible endpoint for agents that don't set one.

models.description: The models at baseUrl, by id, with the thinking levels each accepts in supportsReasoningEffort. Cofold offers the levels it supports.

instructions.description: Default system prompt for agents that don't set one.

computerConfigDir.description: Cofold configuration directory inside a computer. Defaults to '/ahpd/cofold'. Set to false to keep the computer image's own configuration.

store.description: Folder for cofold's file store, shared by every agent. Defaults to '$COFOLD_HOME', or '~/.cofold'.

memory.description: Keep each agent's store in memory instead of on disk. For tests.

tools.description: Which tools a session gets, where web_search finds its providers, and whether a file must be read before it is written.

strictTools.description: Refuse unknown keys in tools. On by default; set to false to drop them instead.

apiKey.description: Default API key for agents that don't set one.

resource.description: Protected resource that clients authenticate against. Defaults to the endpoint's origin when it uses https.

autoCompactTokens.description: History size, in estimated tokens, at which a session compacts. Defaults to the autoCompactAt share of the model's context, or of 32000 when the context is unknown, and never goes above that.

autoCompactAt.description: The share of the model's listed context, or of 32000, a session compacts at when autoCompactTokens names no lower point, copapo's 0.8 by default.

catalogueTimeoutMs.description: How long, in milliseconds, the endpoint is given to publish its catalogue before the configured model stands alone, the time VS Code gives a runtime's model catalogue. 15000 by default.

hostTools.description: Offer the host's tools to each session. On by default. Each agent can override it.
